- apply risk methodologies at the most complex levels of risk
- guide others in applying risk methodologies in proportion to the risk

skills.name: Managing product outcomes
skills.description: Managing product outcomes involves working with teams to identify key performance indicators and developing methods to ensure that value is achieved through your product, linking to the product vision and strategic goals.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the importance of identifying and measuring product outcomes
- explain the need for baseline data
- identify and explain the priority outcomes for your product or feature
levels.working:
You can:
- work with others to define key performance indicators that assess performance, value and outcomes
- analyse and use trusted data to make decisions and enable continuous improvement
- be open about your decision making
- identify and explain success metrics to your stakeholders and how the product can contribute to outcomes
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- lead product teams to create effective methods for measuring product outcomes
- advocate for data-driven decision making
- help others prioritise to make better choices
- use data to drive continuous improvement, increasing quality and user experience
- identify opportunities to share and connect product data
levels.expert:
You can:
- use data to make prioritisation decisions for multiple or complex projects, products or services
- use data to influence priorities of senior stakeholders
- guide and challenge teams to make better use of data
- guide and challenge teams to demonstrate achievement of outcomes
- identify opportunities to share and connect product data across government

skills.name: Managing, reporting and resolving defects
skills.description: Managing, reporting and resolving defects involves reporting progress, outcomes and issues, whilst contributing to improving defect management processes.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain how to report and track defects
- follow a defect management process to report, communicate and maintain defects with appropriate information
- retest and escalate defects when needed
levels.working:
You can:
- collaborate with others to create a defect management process to report, communicate and resolve defects, with support
- critically assess dependencies, defects and risks, with support
- contribute to mitigation and contingency plans
- clearly communicate risks and the impact of defects to stakeholders
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- contribute to developing standards for defect management processes
- manage and escalate dependencies, defects and risks across teams
- contribute to mitigation and contingency plans across teams
- use defect patterns and trends to make recommendations on testing and quality approaches, with support
- manage stakeholder expectations and communications during defect resolution
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead and coach others in improving test and defect management processes
- support others in assessing complex and challenging defects across the organisation
- lead and coach others in using defect patterns and trends to make tactical and strategic recommendations
- influence improvements to quality processes, informed by defect patterns and trends

skills.name: 시장 분석과 소통
skills.description: 공급 시장을 이해하고, 조달에 앞서 공급자와 소통하며, 시장의 근거를 활용해 요구사항, 시장 진입 경로, 상업 모델을 형성한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 프레임워크와 공급자 데이터베이스에서 공급자를 찾는다
- 초기 시장 소통이 모든 공급자에게 공정해야 하는 이유를 설명한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 요구사항에 대한 시장 정보, 가격, 공급자 세부 정보를 모은다
- 정보 제공 요청을 실시하고 응답을 요약한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 공급 시장과 그 경쟁, 리스크, 동향을 분석한다
- 경쟁을 왜곡하지 않으면서 공급자의 날 같은 초기 시장 소통을 이끈다
- 시장의 근거를 활용해 요구사항과 상업 모델을 형성한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 신규 또는 소규모 공급자를 장려하는 등 시장을 형성한다
- 다른 구매 조직과 함께 시장 전략을 이끈다

skills.name: 언론 관계
skills.description: 기자와 관계를 쌓고, 언론 문의를 처리하고, 보도 자료를 쓰고, 인시던트 중을 포함하여 대변인을 준비시킨다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직이 언론 문의를 어떻게 처리하는지 설명한다
- 언론 문의를 즉시 커뮤니케이션 팀에 전달한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 정형적인 언론 문의를 기록하고 응대한다
- 승인을 받을 보도 자료와 성명을 작성한다
- 언론 보도를 모니터링한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 인시던트나 데이터 침해에 관한 문의를 포함하여 민감하고 대응적인 언론 문의를 처리한다
- 대변인에게 상황을 설명하고 준비시킨다
- 보건 및 기술 분야 기자와 관계를 쌓는다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 대규모 인시던트와 위기 중의 언론 대응을 이끈다
- 시니어 이해관계자들 사이에서 조직의 평판을 지키고 높인다
- 평판 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다

skills.name: 의료기기 소프트웨어 규제
skills.description: 소프트웨어가 의료기기에 해당하는 때와, 그에 적용되는 IEC 62304와 ISO 13485 같은 표준 및 프로세스를 이해한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 일부 보건 소프트웨어는 의료기기로 규제됨을 설명한다
- 제품이 의료기기일 수 있을 때 누구에게 물어야 하는지 안다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 의료기기 표준을 충족하는 소프트웨어 생애 주기 프로세스를 따른다
- 그 프로세스가 요구하는 기록을 작성한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 제품이 의료기기인지와 그 가능성이 높은 등급을 평가한다
- 품질 및 임상 동료와 함께 제품의 규제 대응 작업을 계획한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 규제 대상 소프트웨어에 대한 조직의 접근 방식을 정한다
- 규제 기관 및 인증 기관과의 협의를 이끈다

skills.name: Metadata management
skills.description: Metadata management involves establishing policies and processes that ensure data can be accessed across an organisation.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain what metadata is
- maintain the information stored in metadata repositories under the direction of others
levels.working:
You can:
- use metadata repositories to complete complex tasks such as data and systems integration impact analysis
- maintain a metadata repository to ensure information remains accurate and up to date
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- design an appropriate metadata repository
- suggest changes to improve current metadata repositories
- understand a range of tools for storing and working with metadata
- advise less experienced members of the team about metadata management
levels.expert:
You can:
- identify how metadata repositories can support different areas of the organisation
- communicate the value of metadata repositories
- set up robust governance processes to keep repositories up to date

levels.awareness:
You can:
- follow advice to apply the most appropriate tools and techniques to support the planning, analysis, development, testing, implementation and improvement of systems and services
levels.working:
You can:
- select and use the most appropriate tools and techniques to support the planning, analysis, development, testing, implementation and improvement of systems and services within a project
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- build capability in methods and tools, ensuring they are adopted consistently and used effectively
levels.expert:
You can:
- set direction and give others the means and authority to advise on the best methodologies and tools for the work, ensuring they are adopted consistently
- assess the effectiveness of different approaches (such as Agile or plan-driven) and recommend tools to support organisational collaboration and build capability

skills.name: 회의록 작성과 회의 기록
skills.description: 논의, 결정, 조치 사항을 정확하고 간결하게 기록하고 공식 회의 기록을 보관한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 팀 회의에서 조치 사항과 결정을 메모한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 정례 회의의 정확하고 간결한 회의록과 조치 사항 목록을 쓴다
- 담당자와 함께 조치 사항을 후속 관리한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 복잡하거나 논란이 있는 논의를 포함하여 이사회와 위원회의 공식 회의록을 작성한다
- 감사와 조사를 견딜 수 있는 공식 회의 기록을 보관한다
- 기록에 무엇이 담겨야 하는지 의장에게 조언한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직 전반의 공식 회의 기록에 대한 기준을 정한다
- 회의록 작성자를 교육하고 품질을 점검한다

skills.name: Modern development standards
skills.description: Modern development standards involves using the latest technologies and best practices to improve the quality of the software development process.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the importance of using modern development standards
levels.working:
You can:
- explain the most important principles of modern development standards and how they apply to your work
- apply modern development standards principles under guidance
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- apply modern development standards and support others in applying them
levels.expert:
You can:
- identify and apply modern development standards to support complex projects and programmes
- lead others in applying modern development standards

skills.name: 사무 행정
skills.description: 문서 정리, 주문, 데이터 입력, 기록, 사무 절차 준수 등, 팀이나 서비스가 돌아가게 하는 행정 프로세스를 운영한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 문서 정리, 주문, 데이터 입력에 관한 사무 절차를 따른다
- 자신의 업무 기록을 정확하게 남긴다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 감독을 거의 받지 않고 팀을 위한 다양한 행정 프로세스를 운영한다
- 기록과 데이터의 오류를 찾아 고친다
- 더 단순한 업무 방식을 제안한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 서비스나 디렉터레이트의 행정 지원을 조직한다
- 행정 절차를 작성하고 개선한다
- 다른 사무 담당자를 교육하고 업무를 점검한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직 전반의 행정 서비스를 설계한다
- 더 단순한 디지털 행정 프로세스로의 전환을 이끈다

skills.name: Operational management
skills.description: Operational management involves ensuring the operational processes of a product or service are effective and robust.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the operational processes of running and maintaining a product or service
- fix operational issues, under supervision
levels.working:
You can:
- contribute to the design of operational processes for the running and maintenance of products and services
- identify and share opportunities for improvements to operational processes
- fix operational issues, with some support
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- design operational processes for throughout the service life cycle
- redesign and amend existing operational processes
- fix complex operational issues
- act as an escalation point for operational issues
- work closely with operational delivery teams
levels.expert:
You can:
- ensure a scalable operating model is in place to provide a resilient, high quality service
- coordinate teams from operations, policy, digital and delivery to operate and iterate a service
- ensure teams understand the importance of efficient service operations
- identify and overcome operational constraints
- act as the escalation point for major operational issues

skills.name: 조직 변화와 협의
skills.description: 정책과 노동법에 맞춰 공식 협의, 재배치, 정리 해고를 포함하여 조직 구조, 직무, 근무 방식의 변경을 계획하고 관리한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직 변경 프로세스의 주요 단계를 설명한다
- 협의 통지서와 회의 같은 변경의 행정을 지원한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 관리자가 협의 문서와 직원 브리핑을 준비하도록 지원한다
- 협의 중 의견과 조치를 추적한다
- 재배치와 선발 과정에서 직원을 지원한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 비즈니스 케이스부터 실행까지 디렉터레이트의 조직 변경을 이끈다
- 직원과 그 대표와 협의하고 의견에 응답한다
- 변경의 법적 리스크와 평등 관련 리스크를 관리한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직 전체의 구조 개편과 서비스 이전을 이끈다
- 협력적 관계를 포함하여 조직의 변화 접근 방식을 설계한다
- 대규모 변화가 사람에게 미치는 영향과 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다

skills.name: 조직 개발
skills.description: 근거에 기반한 문화, 리더십, 참여, 팀 효과성, 웰빙 개입을 통해 조직이 일하는 방식을 개선한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 문화, 리더십, 참여가 직원과 환자 돌봄에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 설명한다
- 직원 설문과 경청 행사의 운영을 돕는다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 표준 도구를 활용해 팀 세션과 워크숍을 진행한다
- 팀의 직원 설문 결과를 분석하고 조치를 제안한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 문제를 진단하고 이를 해결하는 개입을 설계한다
- 팀 개발, 리더십 개발, 참여 프로그램을 이끈다
- 근거를 활용해 개입의 효과를 평가한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직 개발 전략과 문화 프로그램을 정한다
- 임원을 코칭하고 대규모 문화 변화를 이끈다
- 문화와 참여 지표를 돌봄의 질 및 성과와 연결한다

skills.name: 조직 리스크 관리
skills.description: 리스크 등록부와 정해진 리스크 선호도를 사용하여 조직의 목표에 대한 리스크를 식별하고, 평가하고, 기록하고, 관리한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 리스크가 무엇이고 어떻게 제기하는지 설명한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 자기 영역의 리스크를 기록하고 갱신한다
- 통제 방안을 제안하고 대응을 추적한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 디렉터레이트나 프로그램의 리스크 프로세스를 운영한다
- 리스크를 리스크 선호도에 비추어 평가하고 상위에 보고한다
- 리스크를 위원회에 보고한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 리스크 관리 체계와 리스크 선호도를 설계한다
- 전략적 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다

levels.awareness:
You can:
- show an awareness of problem resolution processes
- pass problems on to your team
levels.working:
You can:
- own an issue until a new owner has been found or the problem has been mitigated or resolved
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- take accountability for issues that occur and be proactive in searching for potential problems
- achieve excellent user outcomes
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead and embed best practice for identifying opportunities and solving problems across teams
- coach others to take accountability, act proactively and consistently achieve excellent outcomes

skills.name: 급여
skills.description: 입사, 퇴사, 변경, 공제, 연금, 법정 지급, 급여 보고를 포함하여 직원에게 정확하고 제때 급여를 지급한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 변경과 마감부터 지급과 보고까지 급여 주기를 설명한다
- 승인된 서식에서 입사자, 퇴사자, 변경 사항을 정확하게 입력한다
- 급여 정보를 비밀로 유지하면서 정형적인 급여 문의에 답한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 급여, 가산 수당, 초과 근무, 병가, 가족 휴가 지급액을 계산한다
- 세금, 연금, 그 밖의 공제를 올바르게 적용한다
- 급여 출력물을 확인하고 지급 전에 오류를 바로잡는다
- 정책에 따라 배려를 갖고 과지급액을 회수한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 직원 집단의 전체 급여를 운영하고 급여 점검을 승인한다
- 법정 급여 보고와 연금 신고를 관리한다
- 복수 계약, 소급 지급, 급여 희생 같은 복잡한 사례를 해결한다
- 연간 임금 인상과 규칙 변경 같은 급여 시스템의 변경을 테스트한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 사내 운영이든 제공자 운영이든, 조직의 급여 서비스를 관리한다
- 급여 통제를 정하고 지급이 정확하고 적법하다는 것을 시니어 리더에게 보증한다
- 급여 규칙, 임금 인상, 급여 시스템의 변화에 대비한다
- 대규모 급여 장애에 대한 대응을 이끈다

skills.name: 피플 매니지먼트
skills.description: 채용, 목표, 평가, 웰빙, 근태를 포함하여 직원을 이끌고, 육성하고, 지원하며 실적과 행위를 공정하게 관리한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 자신에게 영향을 주는 조직의 인사 정책을 설명한다
- 새로 들어온 동료를 돕고 지식을 공유한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 일상 업무를 감독하고 피드백을 준다
- 채용과 입사 교육에 참여한다
- 정기적으로 1대1 면담을 한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 목표를 설정하고 평가를 하며 팀을 직접 관리한다
- 웰빙을 지원하고 근태, 실적, 행위를 관리한다
- 팀의 육성과 승계를 계획한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 매니저를 이끌고 큰 영역의 문화를 형성한다
- 인력 계획과 조직 변경을 설계한다
- 리더를 코칭하고 복잡한 사람 문제를 해결한다

skills.name: 인사 전략과 인사 리더십
skills.description: 조직의 인사 전략을 정하고, 인사 기능을 이끌며, 문화, 인력, 고용 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:

levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 명확한 조치와 지표와 함께 서비스의 인사 계획에 기여한다
- 인사 계획에 대한 진행 상황을 보고한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 인사 전략에 맞춰 디렉터레이트의 인사 계획을 작성하고 이끈다
- 사람에 관한 리스크와 우선순위에 대해 시니어 리더에게 조언한다
- 인사 기능의 일부를 이끌며 그 기준과 우선순위를 정한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 인사 전략을 정하고 인사 기능을 이끈다
- 문화, 인력, 고용 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다
- 사람에 관한 사안에서 파트너와 규제 기관에 조직을 대표한다

skills.name: Performance measurement
skills.description: Performance measurement involves collecting and interpreting data to identify how a team, product or service is performing.

levels.awareness:
You can:

levels.working:

- participate in discussions determining which performance measurements are appropriate, with guidance from more experienced colleagues
- demonstrate experience in turning business needs and goals into performance measures
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- lead the development of performance measurement frameworks including Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
- demonstrate a deep understanding of business goals and can turn these into tangible performance measures
levels.expert:
You can:
- oversee the development and consistency of performance measurement frameworks across multiple projects
- ensure that these frameworks are aligned to business needs and strategy

levels.awareness:
You can:
- understand the importance of planning and forecasting
- show an awareness of the different ways to develop a plan
levels.working: This skill level is currently not defined.
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- understand the environment and prioritise the most important or high value tasks
- use data to inform planning
- manage complex internal and external dependencies
- provide delivery confidence

- ensure that teams plan appropriately for their capacity
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead a continual planning process in a very complex environment
- plan beyond product delivery
- identify dependencies in plans across services and co-ordinate delivery
- coach other teams as the central point of expertise

skills.name: 정책 관리
skills.description: 조직의 정책과 절차를 작성, 검토, 승인, 공표하고 사람들이 이를 따르는지 확인한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 자신의 업무에 적용되는 정책을 찾아서 따른다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 정책 등록부를 최신으로 유지하고 담당자에게 검토 시점을 알린다
- 정책이 올바른 템플릿과 승인 경로를 사용하는지 확인한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 분야 전문가와 함께 정책을 작성하고 검토한다
- 정책을 법률, 표준, 평등 의무에 비추어 확인한다
- 준수 여부를 모니터링하고 공백을 보고한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 정책 체계를 정한다
- 정책의 우선순위와 리스크에 대해 이사회에 조언한다

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the strategic context of your work and why it is important
- collect information that helps with understanding organisational problems
- use architectural representations produced by others, such as a problem definition statement, to support a team
levels.working:
You can:
- help to frame a problem characterised by managed levels of complexity, complication, or risk so that a solution can be created
- help to create options for solving problems at an appropriate level of detail
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- frame a problem characterised by medium complexity, complication, or risk so that a solution can be created
- produce architectural representations that enable different teams to have a shared understanding of problems throughout the life cycle
- describe options for solving problems so that appropriate delivery methods can be decided
levels.expert:
You can:
- lead the framing of a problem characterised by high complexity, complication, or risk so that a solution can be created
- coach others in defining problems and describing appropriate options for solutions
- help others challenge requirements and assumptions, and identify opportunities when defining problems and solution options

esco.label: analyse the context of an organisation

skills.name: Problem management
skills.description: Problem management involves anticipating and identifying problems in systems, processes or services, and ensuring appropriate solutions are implemented.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- investigate problems in systems, processes and services, with an understanding of the level of a problem, for example, strategic, tactical or operational
- contribute to the implementation of remedies and preventative measures
levels.working:
You can:
- initiate and monitor actions to investigate patterns and trends to resolve problems
- effectively consult specialists where required
- determine the appropriate resolution and assist with its implementation
- determine preventative measures
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- ensure that the right actions are taken to investigate, resolve and anticipate problems
- co-ordinate the team to investigate problems, implement solutions and take preventive measures
levels.expert:
You can:
- anticipate problems and defend against them at the right time
- understand how a problem fits into the larger picture
- identify and describe problems, and help others to describe them
- build problem-solving capabilities in others

skills.name: 조달 프로세스
skills.description: 계획과 사양 수립부터 시장 진입 경로, 입찰, 낙찰, 계약 체결까지, 프레임워크와 동적 구매 시스템을 통한 구매를 포함하여 규정을 지키는 조달을 수행한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조달의 단계와 적용되는 기준 금액을 설명한다
- 조직의 규칙에 따라 소액 구매의 견적을 받는다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 표준 템플릿을 사용해 견적과 프레임워크 개별 계약을 수행한다
- 전자 입찰 시스템에서 입찰 서류를 준비하고 질의를 관리한다
- 각 조달의 명확한 감사 증적을 남긴다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 적합한 시장 진입 경로와 절차를 선택하며 복잡한 입찰을 계획하고 이끈다
- 사용자가 디지털 및 임상 시스템의 성과 기반 사양을 쓰도록 돕는다
- 계약 체결까지 일정, 리스크, 이해관계자를 관리한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 조달 절차와 템플릿을 정한다
- 가장 복잡하거나, 가치가 크거나, 새로운 조달을 이끈다
- 이사회를 위해 조달 결정을 보증한다

skills.name: Product leadership
skills.description: Product leadership involves advocating for product management, encouraging a user-focussed, product-led approach and contributing to a self-sustaining product community.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- describe how product management works with other roles in a multi-disciplinary team
- explain how user and business needs should be balanced in product development
- attend product management community activities
levels.working:
You can:
- advocate for your product and a product-led approach
- seek opportunities for reuse and learning in your area
- protect the team, for example, from unnecessary distractions or requests to change direction
- consult and mediate with stakeholders
- participate in product management community activities
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- seek opportunities for reuse and learning across your organisation
- represent product management in your area in conversations with senior stakeholders
- protect teams, for example, from unnecessary distractions and requests to change direction
- coach and manage others in product management
- lead some product management community activities and participate in cross-government communities
levels.expert:
You can:
- seek opportunities for reuse and learning across government
- co-ordinate the product management community
- lead on coaching and mentoring for product management in your organisation
- lead some activities in cross-government communities, establishing and maintaining wider relationships across the profession
- represent product management in your organisation in conversations with senior stakeholders

skills.name: Product management
skills.description: Product management involves making sure that products provide value and drive the right outcomes, whilst balancing user and business needs. This is achieved by working with other professions in your team to frame the problem and make decisions on priorities for your delivery teams.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- explain the value of using a product management approach to provide value and drive the right outcomes
levels.working:
You can:
- create and prioritise actionable goals for your teams, balancing user needs and business perspectives
- make or recommend an evidence-based decision using insight and data
- use a range of product management methods, for example, prioritisation and roadmapping
- work with others in multidisciplinary teams to plan and deliver high-quality product increments
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- work with your team to investigate and validate what adds value now and what could add value in future
- create a prioritised roadmap and use it to discuss your product strategy with stakeholders
- address uncertainty while managing scope, ensuring critical deadlines are met and value delivered
- recommend a range of product management methods
- work in the open and share your work
levels.expert:
You can:
- set the strategy and vision for your products, collaborating with others
- create a prioritised roadmap for your products and use it to discuss product strategy at all levels
- plan prioritised work across multiple teams, minimising dependencies and risks
- support multiple teams in delivering quality outcomes in the right way
- coach and mentor others in product management

skills.name: 프로젝트·포트폴리오 오피스 지원
skills.description: 계획, 등록부, 보고, 문서 관리, 보증 점검 등 프로젝트 및 포트폴리오 오피스의 프로세스를 운영한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 프로젝트 문서를 버전 관리와 함께 올바른 위치에 보관한다
- 요청이 있을 때 조치, 리스크, 이슈 로그를 갱신한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 여러 프로젝트의 계획, 등록부, 트래커를 유지한다
- 진행 상황을 수집하여 정기 현황 보고서를 작성한다
- 프로젝트가 합의된 방법을 따르는지 확인한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 포트폴리오 보고를 설계하고 프로젝트 전반의 진행, 리스크, 편익을 분석한다
- 보증 점검과 게이트웨이 리뷰를 운영한다
- 방법과 통제에 대해 프로젝트 매니저에게 조언한다

skills.name: 프로젝트 관리

- 계획, 리스크·이슈 로그, 보고서를 유지한다
- 프로젝트 회의를 운영하고 조치 사항을 추적한다
- 지원을 받아 작고 명확하게 정의된 프로젝트를 관리한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 범위, 기간, 비용, 품질을 관리하며 시작부터 종료까지 프로젝트를 관리한다

- 프로젝트 관리 기준을 정하고 프로젝트 매니저를 코칭한다
- 정체된 프로젝트를 되살린다

skills.name: Prototyping

skills.name: 가명처리와 공개 통제

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 식별 가능한 데이터, 가명처리된 데이터, 익명처리된 데이터의 차이를 설명한다
- 결과물에서 소수 값을 가리는 조직의 규칙을 따른다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:

- 연결되었거나 상세한 데이터로 환자를 식별할 수 있는 경우를 알아본다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 식별자를 분석 데이터와 분리해 두는 가명처리와 연결 방법을 설계한다
- 데이터 세트나 공표물의 재식별 위험을 평가하고 적절한 통제를 선택한다
- 신뢰할 수 있는 연구 환경 같은 안전한 환경에 대해 팀에 조언한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 비식별화와 공개 통제에 관한 조직의 기준을 정한다
- 고위험 데이터 공개와 연결 프로젝트를 보증한다
- 연구와 계획을 위한 안전한 데이터 접근에 관해 파트너와의 협업을 이끈다

skills.name: 공공 조달법

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 공공 기관이 조달 규칙을 따라야 하는 이유를 설명한다
- 구매 활동에 조달 또는 법률 자문이 필요한 때를 알아본다
levels.working:

- 공정하고 투명한 절차를 보여 주는 데 필요한 기록 관리를 지원한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:

- 평가, 낙찰 결정, 낙찰 후 계약 변경에 대해 조언한다

- 파트너십에서의 보조금 통제와 경쟁 리스크에 대해 조언한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조달 관련 법적 리스크에 대한 조직의 접근 방식을 정한다
- 혁신 파트너십처럼 가치가 크거나 새로운 조달을 이끈다
- 중대한 조달 이의 제기에 대응한다

skills.name: 공공 조달 규칙과 정책
skills.description: 구매가 적법하고, 투명하며, 공정하도록 공공 조달 규칙, 조직의 재무 규칙, 조달 정책을 적용한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 공적 자금은 공정하고, 공개적이며, 적법하게 써야 함을 설명한다
- 조직의 기준 금액과 승인 규칙을 따른다

levels.practitioner:

skills.name: Quality assurance of data and analysis

levels.working:

- undertake quality assurance processes

levels.practitioner:
You can:

- specify how data should be cleansed and prepared
- bring data together from different sources
- communicate the limitations of data
levels.expert:
You can:

- use appropriate approaches for verifying and validating data and analysis
- influence senior stakeholders over data and analysis approaches
- coach and mentor others in assuring data and analysis

levels.working:

- 보관 또는 안전한 폐기를 위해 기록을 준비하고 감사 추적을 유지한다
levels.practitioner:

levels.expert:

levels.awareness:

levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:

- 디지털 직무의 기술 과제처럼 전문 직무에 맞는 평가를 설계한다
- 채용 데이터를 분석하여 채용 소요 기간, 품질, 다양성을 개선한다

skills.name: 디지털 분야의 면허 임상 실무

- 면허와 계속 전문성 개발을 최신 상태로 유지한다
- 워크플로, 콘텐츠, 안전에 대해 임상적 의견을 낸다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 디지털 서비스가 돌봄에 미치는 영향에 대해 건전한 임상 판단을 내린다
- 디지털이든 임상 현장이든, 안전하지 않은 관행에 자신 있게 이의를 제기한다
- 다른 임상의가 직업 기준을 디지털 업무에 적용하도록 지원한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 디지털 업무에 대한 임상 직업 기준을 이끈다
- 환자 안전과 돌봄에 관한 결정에서 임상 분야의 상급 목소리 역할을 한다

- evaluate and choose approaches for building your team’s understanding of the user
- advocate for user research with sceptical colleagues and stakeholders
- help inexperienced teams to adopt user-centred practices
- identify the most important challenges and opportunities for your team's service development
- align research plans to address team priorities
levels.expert:
You can:
- find ways to help an organisation adopt user-centred practices and appreciate the value of understanding users
- ensure discussions at senior levels or between organisations consider user needs and evolving user behaviour
- help an organisation understand the complete journey of the user and use this knowledge to improve their services

skills.name: 취약점 관리
skills.description: 스캔, 침투 테스트, 패치 적용을 포함하여 기술적 취약점을 찾고, 평가하고, 우선순위를 정하고, 수정한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 신속한 패치 적용과 안전한 구성이 중요한 이유를 설명한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 취약점 스캔을 실행하고 결과를 보고한다
- 시스템 담당자와 함께 수정 사항을 추적한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 환자 서비스에 대한 위험을 포함하여 리스크에 따라 취약점의 우선순위를 정한다
- 침투 테스트와 시정 조치의 범위를 정하고 관리한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 취약점 관리 정책과 그 목표를 정한다
- 기술적 보안 리스크를 시니어 리더에게 보고한다

skills.name: Web performance optimisation
skills.description: Web performance optimisation involves improving the efficiency and speed with which web pages load in a browser.

levels.awareness:
You can:
- describe the basic principles of web performance
- explain why web performance is important
- help improve web performance under supervision
levels.working:
You can:
- explain the principles of web performance
- explain how poor performance can negatively affect user experience
- help improve web performance
- help identify and resolve web performance issues
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- identify and resolve web performance issues
- collect data to monitor and resolve web performance issues
- guide on the best web performance optimisation software and methods to use
levels.expert:
You can:
- advocate for web performance optimisation best practices
- coach and guide others
- actively collect data from multiple tools to monitor and resolve web performance issues

skills.name: 인력 정보와 인사 시스템
skills.description: 인사 및 인력 시스템과 데이터를 관리하고, 이직, 결근, 결원, 다양성, 임금 격차 분석 같은 인력 데이터를 보고서와 통찰로 바꾼다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 인사 시스템에 인력 데이터를 정확하게 입력한다
- 인력 데이터를 정확하게 유지하고 기밀로 다뤄야 하는 이유를 설명한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 표준 인력 보고서를 실행하고 오류가 없는지 확인한다
- 인력에 관한 정형적인 정보 요청에 답한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 인력 데이터를 분석하여 경향을 찾고 관리자에게 설명한다
- 인력 지표를 위한 대시보드와 보고서를 설계한다
- 임금 격차 분석 같은 법정 보고와 평등 보고를 작성한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 인력 정보 전략과 데이터 기준을 정한다
- 인사 시스템의 선택과 개발을 이끈다
- 인력에 관한 통찰로 이사회의 결정에 정보를 제공한다

skills.name: 인력 계획
skills.description: 조직에 필요한 인력을 예측하고, 보유한 인력과 비교하며, 채용, 육성, 재설계, 유지를 통해 그 격차를 메우는 방법을 계획한다.

levels.awareness:
할 수 있는 일:
- 안전하고 지속 가능한 서비스에 인력 계획이 중요한 이유를 설명한다
- 정원과 결원에 관한 정확한 정보를 제공한다
levels.working:
할 수 있는 일:
- 관리자로부터 인력 계획 데이터를 수집하고 확인한다
- 이직과 결원 추세 같은 단순한 시나리오를 모델링한다
levels.practitioner:
할 수 있는 일:
- 서비스 계획 및 재무 계획과 연결하여 디렉터레이트의 인력 계획을 이끈다
- 기술의 격차를 파악하고 이를 메울 방법을 권고한다
- 새로운 직무, 경력 경로, 기술 구성을 계획한다
levels.expert:
할 수 있는 일:
- 조직의 인력 전략과 장기 계획을 정한다
- 재무 및 서비스 리더와 함께 서비스 간 인력의 득실을 조정한다
- 보건·돌봄 시스템 전반의 파트너와 인력 계획을 형성한다

levels.awareness:
You can:
- show an awareness of ethical and operational constraints
levels.working:
You can:
- identify, understand, communicate and work within constraints
- challenge the validity of constraints
- ensure that standards are being met
- show an understanding of security and data privacy
levels.practitioner:
You can:
- work with and challenge senior stakeholders
- prioritise and mitigate constraints and can turn them into an advantage
- adapt the approach according to constraints
- demonstrate a good knowledge of security and data privacy
levels.expert:
You can:
- influence, challenge and coach others
- anticipate how constraints might change and know where to challenge or remove constraints
- demonstrate a very strong knowledge of security and data privacy
- describe and work within environmental constraints, finding the most appropriate solution for users

occupations.label: legal administrative assistant
occupations.description: Legal administrative assistants carry out the daily administrative activities of firms, offices of notaries, and companies. They perform activities such as writing mails, phone-answering and typing/keyboarding. They combine these activities with specific knowledge and understanding of the procedures and codes managed in legal business affairs.

essential.label: meet deadlines for preparing legal cases

occupations.label: administrative assistant
occupations.description: Administrative assistants provide administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

occupations.label: ICT security administrator
occupations.isco08Label: Database and network professionals not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT security administrators plan and carry out security measures to protect information and data from unauthorised access, deliberate attack, theft and corruption.

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: procurement category specialist
occupations.description: Procurement category specialists are experts in specific markets and contract types and provide advanced knowledge of a particular category of supplies, services or works. They help internal or external clients to increase value for money and end users' satisfaction through their advanced knowledge of the suppliers and their offering.

essential.label: develop performance orientation in public administration
monitor developments in field of expertise

optional.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics

occupations.label: recruitment consultant
occupations.description: Recruitment consultants provide the suitable candidates to employers according to the specific job profile requested. They perform testing and interviewing with job seekers, shortlist few candidates to present to the employers and match candidates to appropriate jobs. Recruitment consultants maintain relationships with employers to offer their services on a more long-term basis.

essential.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
support employability of people with disabilities

optional.label: personal reflection techniques based on feedback

occupations.label: integration engineer
occupations.description: Integration engineers develop and implement solutions which coordinate applications across the enterprise or its units and departments. They evaluate existing components or systems to determine integration requirements and ensure that the final solutions meet organisational needs. They reuse components when possible and assist management in taking decisions. They perform ICT system integration troubleshooting.

occupations.label: ICT test analyst
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT test analysts work in testing environments, assessing products, checking for quality and accuracy, or creating tests scripts. They design tests which are then implemented by testers.

occupations.label: corporate trainer
occupations.description: Corporate trainers train, coach, and guide employees of a company to teach and improve their skills, competences and knowledge in accordance with the needs of the company. They develop the existing potential of the employees to increase their efficiency, motivation, job satisfaction, and employability.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise

occupations.label: cyber incident responder
occupations.isco08Label: Database and network professionals not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Cyber incident responders monitor and assess cybersecurity state systems, analysing, evaluating, and mitigating the impact of cybersecurity incidents. Moreover, they identify malicious actors and cyber incidents root causes. According to the organisation’s Incident Response Plan, they restore systems and process functionalities to an operational state, collecting evidence and documenting actions taken.

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: software tester
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Software testers perform software tests. They may also plan and design them. They may also debug and repair software although this mainly corresponds to designers and developers. They ensure that applications function properly before delivering them to internal and external clients.

occupations.label: ICT help desk manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT help desk managers monitor the delivery of technical support services to clients according to the predefined deadlines. They plan and organise the user support actions and troubleshoot ICT problems and issues. ICT help desk managers supervise the help desk team ensuring that the customers get the appropriate feedback and support. They also participate in developing customer service guidelines and in reinforcing the team.

essential.label: keep up to date on product knowledge

occupations.label: medical records clerk
occupations.isco08Label: Medical records and health information technicians
occupations.description: Medical records clerks organise, keep up-to-date and archive patients` records for medical staff availability. They transfer medical information from a patient’s paper records to an electronic template.

essential.label: administrative tasks in a medical environment
comply with quality standards related to healthcare practice
use electronic health records management system

optional.label: communicate in foreign languages with health service providers
participate in medical records' auditing activities
work in a multicultural environment in health care

occupations.label: data warehouse designer
occupations.description: Data warehouse designers are responsible for planning, connecting, designing, scheduling, and deploying data warehouse systems. They develop, monitor and maintain ETL processes, reporting applications and data warehouse design.

occupations.label: data protection officer
occupations.description: Data protection officers ensure that the processing of personal data in an organisation is compliant with data protection standards and with the obligations set out in the applicable legislation such as GDPR. They elaborate and implement the organisation policy related to data protection, are responsible for data protection impact assessments and handle complaints and requests from third parties and regulatory agencies. Data protection officers lead investigations into potential data breaches, conduct internal audits and act as point of contact within the organisation on any matters related to the processing of personal data. Data protection officers may develop training programmes and provide training to other employees on data protection procedures.

optional.label: conduct impact evaluation of ICT processes on business

occupations.label: data engineer
occupations.description: Data engineers develop the architecture needed to process, manage, and store large amounts of data which will be used by data scientists for analysis. They design the infrastructure and maintain data pipelines and warehouses to leverage data for strategic advantage.

occupations.label: business intelligence manager
occupations.description: Business intelligence managers gain knowledge of the industry, the innovative processes therein, and contrast them with the operations of the company in order to improve them. They focus their analysis in the supply chain processes, warehouses, storage, and sales as to facilitate communication and revenue improvement.

essential.label: analyse the context of an organisation
create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
integrate strategic foundation in daily performance

optional.label: keep updated on innovations in various business fields

occupations.label: data scientist
occupations.description: Data scientists find and interpret rich data sources, manage large amounts of data, merge data sources, ensure consistency of data-sets, and create visualisations to aid in understanding data. They build mathematical models using data, present and communicate data insights and findings to specialists and scientists in their team and if required, to a non-expert audience, and recommend ways to apply the data.

essential.label: apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles in research activities
develop professional network with researchers and scientists
disseminate results to the scientific community
draft scientific or academic papers and technical documentation
increase the impact of science on policy and society
interact professionally in research and professional environments
manage findable accessible interoperable and reusable data
promote the participation of citizens in scientific and research activities

optional.label: teach in academic or vocational contexts

occupations.label: chief ICT security officer
occupations.isco08Label: Database and network professionals not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Chief ICT security officers protect company and employee information against unauthorized access. They also define the Information System security policy, manage security deployment across all Information Systems and ensure the provision of information availability.

essential.label: ensure adherence to organisational ICT standards
establish an ICT security prevention plan
establish an Information Security Management System
maintain plan for continuity of operations
monitor developments in field of expertise

optional.label: apply operations for an ITIL-based environment
conduct impact evaluation of ICT processes on business
control objectives for information and related technology

occupations.label: purchaser
occupations.description: Purchasers select and purchase stock, materials, services or goods. They organise tender procedures and select suppliers.

essential.label: ensure compliance with purchasing and contracting regulations

optional.label: report accounts of the professional activity

occupations.label: executive assistant
occupations.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.

essential.label: communicate schedules to the people concerned

occupations.label: enterprise architect
occupations.description: Enterprise architects balance technological opportunities with business requirements. They also maintain a holistic view of the organisation's strategy, processes, information and ICT assets and link the business mission, strategy and processes to the ICT strategy.

essential.label: keep up with the latest information systems solutions
review development process of an organisation

occupations.label: contract manager
occupations.description: Contract managers oversee the respect of awarded contracts to ensure that services are delivered as foreseen and that each step of the delivery is properly documented. They act as the main point of contact for suppliers on contractual matters and report back to their leadership. They implement financial and operational controls and ensure compliance with all reporting requirements.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics
develop performance orientation in public administration

occupations.label: cloud architect
occupations.description: Cloud architects are responsible for converting the technical features of a project into the architecture to lead to the final product. To develop technical cloud strategy, they have in-depth knowledge of the architectural principles and services, assisting with cloud migration efforts, review workload architectures, and provide guidance on how to address high-risk issues. They typically perform in a pre-sales capacity and are often asked to deliver proof-of-concept projects, topical workshops, and lead implementation projects. They team up with DevOps engineers to build the appropriate technologies.

occupations.label: financial manager
occupations.description: Financial managers handle all the matters in reference to the finance and investments of a company. They manage financial operations of companies such as the assets, liabilities, equity and cash flow aiming to maintain the financial health of the company and operative viability. Financial managers evaluate the strategic plans of the company in financial terms, maintain transparent financial operations for taxation and auditing bodies, and create the financial statements of the company at the end of the fiscal year.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company
report on overall management of a business

occupations.label: legal consultant
occupations.description: Legal consultants advise a varied array of clients ranging from business, individuals, up to legal firms. They provide legal advisory outside courtrooms in relation to legal affairs which depend on the nature of the client. They advise in matters such as merging of multinationals, housing purchase, modification of contracts and its implications. They help clients in general to abide by the regulations and avoid committing illegal acts.

optional.label: European Structural and Investment Funds regulations

occupations.label: cloud engineer
occupations.description: Cloud engineers are responsible for the design, planning, management and maintenance of cloud-based systems. They develop and implement cloud-applications, handle the migration of existing on-premise applications to the cloud, and debug cloud stacks.

occupations.label: artificial intelligence engineer
occupations.description: Artificial intelligence engineer apply methods of artificial intelligence in engineering, robotics and computer science to design programs which simulate intelligence including thinking models, cognitive and knowledge-based systems, problem solving, and decision making. They also integrate structured knowledge into computer systems (ontologies, knowledge bases) in order to solve complex problems normally requiring a high level of human expertise or artificial intelligence methods.

occupations.label: purchasing manager
occupations.description: Purchasing managers are in charge of buying goods, equipment and services for their company, and try to ensure the most competitive prices. They are also responsible for negotiating contracts, reviewing the quality of products and analysing suppliers, and for the use and resale of goods and services.

optional.label: calculate purchasing levels of raw materials

occupations.label: ICT change and configuration manager
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT change and configuration managers organise and implement a process to manage changes throughout the lifecycle of ICT assets such as software, applications, ICT systems, etc. ICT change and configuration managers have a sound knowledge of the main technologies and processes used in system engineering and to manage the lifecycle of ICT systems and subsystems.

optional.label: apply operations for an ITIL-based environment
control objectives for information and related technology

occupations.label: ICT technician
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT technicians install, maintain, repair and operate information systems and any ICT related equipment (laptops, desktops, servers, tablets, smart phones, communications equipment, printers and any piece of computer related peripheral networks), and any type of software (drivers, operating systems, applications).

essential.label: keep up to date on product knowledge

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: ICT business analysis manager
occupations.description: ICT business analysis managers identify areas where information system changes are needed to support business plans and monitor the impact in terms of change management. They contribute to the general ICT functional requirements of the business organisation. ICT business analysis managers analyse business needs and translate them into ICT solutions.

essential.label: propose ICT solutions to business problems

optional.label: provide training on technological business developments

occupations.label: budget analyst
occupations.description: Budget analysts monitor the spending activities of public and private institutions and companies. They prepare budget reports, review the budget model used in the company and ensure compliance with the budgeting policies and other legal regulations.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company

optional.label: consider economic criteria in decision making

occupations.label: ICT accessibility tester
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT accessibility testers evaluate websites, software applications, systems or user interface components with regards to friendliness, operability of the navigation and visibility to all types of users, especially including those with special needs or disabilities.

essential.label: assess users' interaction with ICT applications
test system accessibility for users with special needs

occupations.label: project support officer
occupations.description: Project support officers provide different types of services for the successful execution of a project as part of a horizontal project management office. They offer administrative support, assistance and training to project managers and other staff members, manage the project’s documentation and assist the project manager with project scheduling, resource planning, coordination and reporting. Project support officers are responsible for quality assurance activities and for monitoring the adherence to methodology guidelines and other organisational standards. They also offer advice on project management tools and related administrative services.

essential.label: monitor the conformance to the project methodology

optional.label: manage standard enterprise resource planning system
organise information on availability of the team

occupations.label: financial controller
occupations.description: Financial controllers handle all tasks related to the budgeting and accounting aspects of a company or organisation. They implement and ensure compliance with internal financial and accounting procedures, and prepare documentation for external audits. They collect information related to financial statements such as assets, liabilities, equity, and cash flow in order to assess the company's financial position to prepare annual budgets and forecasts.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company

occupations.label: business analyst
occupations.description: Business analysts research and understand the strategic position of businesses and companies in relation to their markets and their stakeholders. They analyse and present their views on how the company, from many perspectives, can improve its strategic position and internal corporate structure. They assess needs for change, communication methods, technology, IT tools, new standards and certifications.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company

optional.label: keep updated on the political landscape
propose ICT solutions to business problems
shape organisational teams based on competencies
support implementation of quality management systems

occupations.label: clinical coder
occupations.isco08Label: Medical records and health information technicians
occupations.description: Clinical coders read patients' medical records. They analyse and interpret medical statements about diseases, injuries and procedures. Clinical coders convert this information into health classification codes in order to calculate treatment reimbursements, to produce statistics and to monitor health care performance.

essential.label: use electronic health records management system

occupations.label: office clerk
occupations.description: Office clerks are responsible for performing clerical and administrative duties in an office setting and support of business operations within a department. They assist all the administrative staff, secretaries, and assistants by sorting mail, filing forms and documents, answering phones, greeting clients and scheduling meetings.

occupations.label: data quality specialist
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Data quality specialists review organisation's data for accuracy, recommend enhancements to record systems and data acquisition processes and assess referential and historical integrity of data. They also develop documents and maintain data quality goals and standards and oversee an organisation's data privacy policy and monitor compliance of data flows against data quality standards.

occupations.label: cybersecurity risk manager
occupations.isco08Label: Database and network professionals not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Cybersecurity risk managers identify, analyse, assess, estimate and mitigate cybersecurity-related risks of ICT infrastructures such as systems or services. They manage these aspects by planning risk analysis, applying, reporting, assessing, communicating, and treating them. They establish a risk management strategy for the organisation and ensure that risks remain at an acceptable level for the organisation by selecting mitigation actions and controls.

essential.label: ensure adherence to organisational ICT standards
establish an ICT security prevention plan
establish an Information Security Management System

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: regulatory affairs manager
occupations.description: Regulatory affairs managers are in charge of regulatory and legal affairs in several sectors such as the healthcare, energy and banking industries. They oversee the development of products and services from inception to market release by making sure everything complies with the local legislation and meets regulatory requirements. They have experience in the different phases of regulatory processes and act as an interface between business and government legislation or regulatory boards.

essential.label: integrate strategic foundation in daily performance
meet the requirements of legal bodies

optional.label: hazard analysis and critical control points
keep updated on innovations in various business fields

occupations.label: public finance accountant
occupations.description: Public finance accountants head the treasury department of a governmental institution. They manage the institution's financial administration, expenditure and income generation, and compliance with taxation and other financial legislation. They perform administrative duties to ensure record keeping, develop plans for budget management and perform financial forecasts.

occupations.label: ICT information and knowledge manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT information and knowledge managers contribute to the definition of organisational information strategy and apply information and knowledge creation, editing, storage, and distribution policies. They manage the maintenance and evolution of structured and unstructured information. They create digital structures to enable exploitation and optimisation of information and knowledge, manage data analysis and enable business intelligence.

essential.label: analyse the context of an organisation

optional.label: interact with users to gather requirements
keep up with the latest information systems solutions

occupations.label: chief information officer
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: Chief information officers define and implement the ICT strategy and governance. They determine necessary resources for the ICT strategy implementation, anticipate ICT market evolutions and company business needs. They contribute to the development of the organisation's strategic plan and ensure that the ICT infrastructure supports the organisation's overall operations and priorities.

essential.label: ensure adherence to organisational ICT standards
maintain plan for continuity of operations
review development process of an organisation

optional.label: establish an ICT customer support process
lead technology development of an organisation

occupations.label: user interface developer
occupations.description: User interface developers implement, code, document and maintain the interface of a software system by using front-end development technologies.

occupations.label: ICT project manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT project managers schedule, control and direct the resources, people, funding and facilities to achieve the objectives of ICT projects. They establish budgets and timelines, perform risk analysis and quality management, and complete project closure reports.

essential.label: define roadmap for blockchain in applications

occupations.label: database administrator
occupations.description: Database administrators test, implement and administer computer databases. They use their expertise in database management systems to plan, coordinate and implement security measures to safeguard computer databases. They also use scripts and configuration files to tailor a database to users' needs.

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: technical communicator
occupations.description: Technical communicators prepare clear, concise and professional communication from product developers to users of the products such as online help, user manuals, white papers, specifications and industrial videos. For this, they analyse products, legal requirements, markets, customers and users. They develop information and media concepts, standards, structures and software tool support. They plan the content creation and media production processes, develop written, graphical, video or other contents, generate media output, release their information products and receive feedback from the users.

essential.label: develop documentation in accordance with legal requirements

occupations.label: database designer
occupations.description: Database designers specify the database's logical structure, processes, and information flows. They design data models and databases to serve data acquisition.

occupations.label: procurement department manager
occupations.description: Procurement department managers ensure that the organisation's policy goals are transformed into concrete actions and support their teams to achieve the best results for their clients and the public. They oversee the public procurement professionals in the organisation to deliver on their objectives.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics
develop performance orientation in public administration
monitor developments in field of expertise

occupations.label: legal assistant
occupations.description: Legal assistants work closely together with lawyers and legal representatives in the research and preparation of cases brought to courts. They assist in the paper work of cases and management of the administrative side of court affairs.

essential.label: meet deadlines for preparing legal cases

occupations.label: user interface designer
occupations.description: User interface designers are in charge of designing user interfaces for applications and systems. They perform layout, graphics and dialogues design activities as well as adaptation activities.

essential.label: assess users' interaction with ICT applications
interact with users to gather requirements
test system accessibility for users with special needs

occupations.label: lawyer
occupations.description: Lawyers provide legal advice to clients and act on their behalf in legal proceedings and in compliance with the law. They research for, interpret and study cases to represent their clients in a variety of settings such as courts and administrative boards. They create arguments on behalf of their clients for lawsuits in different contexts with the aim of finding a legal remedy.

optional.label: advise on participation in financial markets

occupations.label: medical records manager
occupations.isco08Label: Medical records and health information technicians
occupations.description: Medical records managers are responsible for managing activities of medical records units which maintain and secure patient data. They supervise, oversee and train employees while implementing medical department policies.

essential.label: comply with legislation related to health care
participate in medical records' auditing activities
use e-health and mobile health technologies
use electronic health records management system
work in a multicultural environment in health care

optional.label: meet the requirements of social security reimbursement bodies

occupations.label: ICT system administrator
occupations.description: ICT system administrators are responsible for the upkeep, configuration, and reliable operation of computer and network systems, servers, workstations and peripheral devices. They may acquire, install, or upgrade computer components and software; automate routine tasks; write computer programs; troubleshoot; train and supervise staff; and provide technical support. They ensure optimum system integrity, security, backup and performance.

optional.label: interact with users to gather requirements
remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: product manager
occupations.description: Product managers are responsible for managing the lifecycle of a product. They research and develop new products in addition to managing existing ones through market research and strategic planning. Product managers perform marketing and planning activities to increase profits.

essential.label: combine business technology with user experience
draw conclusions from market research results
organise participation in local or international events

optional.label: create prototype of user experience solutions
integrate marketing strategies with the global strategy
manage the handling of promotional materials

occupations.label: corporate training manager
occupations.description: Corporate training managers coordinate all the training activities and development programmes in a company. They also design and develop new training modules and supervise all the activities related to the planning and delivery of these programmes.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise
promote gender equality in business contexts
provide training in sustainable tourism development and management

optional.label: health and safety in the workplace
plan medium to long term objectives

occupations.label: ICT quality assurance manager
occupations.isco08Label: Software and applications developers and analysts not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: ICT quality assurance managers establish and operate an ICT quality approach through quality management systems, in compliance with internal and external standards and the organisation's culture. They ensure that the management controls are correctly implemented to safeguard asset, data integrity and operations. They focus on the achievement of quality goals, including the maintenance of the external certification according to quality standards and monitor statistics to forecast quality outcomes.

essential.label: attend to detail in preparation for audits

occupations.label: ICT security technician
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT security technicians propose and implement necessary security updates and measures whenever is required. They advise, support, inform and provide training and security awareness.

essential.label: establish an ICT security prevention plan

optional.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: web content manager
occupations.description: Web content managers curate or create content for a web platform according to the long-term strategic goals, policies and procedures for an organisation's online content or their customers. They control and monitor compliance with standards, legal and privacy regulations and ensure web optimisation. They are also responsible for integrating the work of writers and designers to produce a final layout which is compatible with corporate standards.

occupations.label: ICT product manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT product managers analyse and define current and target status for ICT products, services or solutions. They estimate the cost effectiveness, points of risk, opportunities, strengths and weaknesses of products or services provided. ICT product managers create structured plans and establish time scales and milestones, ensuring optimisation of activities and resources.

essential.label: conduct impact evaluation of ICT processes on business

optional.label: interact with users to gather requirements

occupations.label: ICT help desk agent
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology user support technicians
occupations.description: ICT help desk agents provide technical assistance to computer users, answer questions or solve computer problems for clients via telephone or electronically. They provide assistance concerning the use of computer hardware and software.

essential.label: keep up to date on product knowledge

occupations.label: statistician
occupations.description: Statisticians collect, tabulate, and, most importantly, analyse quantitative information coming from a varied array of fields. They interpret and analyse statistical studies on fields such as health, demographics, finance, business, etc. and advise based on patterns and drawn analysis.

essential.label: apply research ethics and scientific integrity principles in research activities
develop professional network with researchers and scientists
disseminate results to the scientific community
draft scientific or academic papers and technical documentation
increase the impact of science on policy and society
interact professionally in research and professional environments
manage findable accessible interoperable and reusable data
promote the participation of citizens in scientific and research activities

optional.label: teach in academic or vocational contexts

occupations.label: payroll clerk
occupations.description: Payroll clerks manage the time sheets and pay checks of the employees and ensure the accuracy and correctness of the information. They check overtime, sick days and vacations and distribute the pay checks.

occupations.label: corporate risk manager
occupations.description: Corporate risk managers identify and assess potential threats and opportunities to a company, and give advice on how to deal with them. They create preventive plans to avoid and reduce risks, and put plans in place for when the company is threatened. They coordinate risk management aspects across the different functions of an organisation and are responsible for technical activities such as risk assessment, risk mapping and insurance purchase. They report on risk issues to the senior management and the company's board.

optional.label: identify if a company is a going concern
keep updated on the political landscape

occupations.label: database developer
occupations.description: Database developers program, implement and coordinate changes to computer databases based on their expertise of database management systems.

essential.label: data extraction, transformation and loading tools

occupations.label: ICT application developer
occupations.description: ICT application developers implement the ICT (software) applications based on the designs provided using application domain specific languages, tools, platforms and experience.

essential.label: propose ICT solutions to business problems

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: project manager
occupations.isco08Label: Business services and administration managers not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Project managers oversee the project on a daily basis and are responsible for delivering high-quality results within the identified objectives and constraints, ensuring the effective use of the allocated resources. They are responsible for risk and issue management, project communication and stakeholder management. Project managers perform the activities of planning, organising, securing, monitoring and managing the resources and work necessary to deliver specific project goals and objectives in an effective and efficient way.

optional.label: find a replacement for stage manager
manage standard enterprise resource planning system

occupations.label: accounting assistant
occupations.description: Accounting assistants record and report ticketing accounting situations to the accountant they work with, verify deposits and prepare daily reports and income. They arrange authorised refund vouchers, maintain the returned check accounts and communicate with ticketing managers concerning about any issues with ticketing systems.

essential.label: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

occupations.label: public relations officer
occupations.description: Public relations officers represent a company or organisation to stakeholders and the public. They use communications strategies to promote an understanding of the activities and image of their clients in a favourable way.

essential.label: integrate strategic foundation in daily performance

optional.label: ethics of sharing work through social media

occupations.label: web developer
occupations.description: Web developers develop, implement and document web-accessible software based on the designs provided. They align the client's web presence with its business strategy, troubleshoot software problems and issues and look for ways to improve the application.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: programme manager
occupations.description: Programme managers coordinate and oversee several projects working simultaneously. They ensure workability and compatibility among projects ensuring that overall, each one of the projects under the management of project managers, turn out profitable and leveraging one to the other.

essential.label: utilise economies of scale in projects

optional.label: analyse financial performance of a company
integrate headquarter's guidelines into local operations
shape organisational teams based on competencies

occupations.label: procurement support officer
occupations.description: Procurement support officers assist the staff of the procurement team throughout the procurement processes, making sure all procurement documents are compliant with procedural, technical and legal requirements, and that meetings and other contacts are well organised.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics

optional.label: develop performance orientation in public administration

occupations.label: public procurement specialist
occupations.description: Public procurement specialists are full-time public procurement practitioners working as part of a procurement team in a large organisation or central purchasing body in all phases of the procurement cycle. They translate needs into contracts and deliver value for money for the organisation and the public.

essential.label: adhere to organisational code of ethics
develop performance orientation in public administration

optional.label: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
monitor developments in field of expertise

occupations.label: cloud DevOps engineer
occupations.description: Cloud DevOps engineers implement and manage continuous software delivery systems and methodologies. This includes managing and configuring code repositories, build services, automated testing, and deployment mechanisms. For cloud-based workloads, a Cloud DevOps Engineer define and deploy infrastructure as code, automating test and development environments. They can define and configure automated disaster recovery solutions that meet business objectives.

occupations.label: communication manager
occupations.description: Communication managers are responsible for developing communication strategies in order to promote the organization's mission, services or product. They coordinate communication projects and manage the communications issued by the company for both the internal and the external clients. They supervise internal communications, ensuring that communications reach each one of the employees and further questions can be answered. For external communications, they coordinate coherence among the messages transmitted in mails, printed materials, press articles, and corporate promotional materials. They strive to maintain truthful communications.

essential.label: ethics of sharing work through social media
integrate strategic foundation in daily performance
organise participation in local or international events

optional.label: study communications channels for different employers/contractors

occupations.label: ICT network engineer
occupations.description: ICT network engineers implement, maintain and support computer networks. They also perform network modelling, analysis, and planning. They may also design network and computer security measures. They may research and recommend network and data communications hardware and software.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans
remove computer virus or malware from a computer

occupations.label: software architect
occupations.description: Software architects create the technical design and the functional model of a software system, based on functional specifications. They also design the architecture of the system or different modules and components related to the business' or customer requirements, technical platform, computer language or development environment.

occupations.label: human resources officer
occupations.description: Human resources officers develop and implement strategies that help their employers select and retain appropriately qualified staff within that business sector. They recruit staff, prepare job advertisements, interview and short-list people, negotiate with employment agencies, and set up working conditions. Human resources officers also administer the payroll, review salaries and advise on remuneration benefits and employment law. They arrange for training opportunities to enhance employees' performance.

optional.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
personal reflection techniques based on feedback
support employability of people with disabilities

occupations.label: data analyst
occupations.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

occupations.label: human resources assistant
occupations.description: Human resources assistants provide support in all the processes and efforts carried by human resources managers. They help in the preparation of recruitment processes by scanning CVs and narrowing the selection to the most suitable candidates. They perform administrative tasks, prepare communications and letters, and perform the tabulation of the surveys and assessments carried out by the department.

optional.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
support employability of people with disabilities

occupations.label: ICT network architect
occupations.description: ICT network architects design the topology and connectivity of ICT network such as hardware, infrastructure, communication and hardware components.

occupations.label: ICT system architect
occupations.description: ICT system architects design architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a multi-components system to meet specified requirements.

occupations.label: accountant
occupations.description: Accountants review and analyse financial statements, budgets, financial reports, and business plans in order to check for irregularities resulting from error or fraud, and provide their clients with financial advice in matters such as financial forecasting and risk analysis. They may audit financial data, resolve insolvency cases, prepare tax returns and provide other tax-related advice in reference to current legislation.

essential.label: analyse financial performance of a company
attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

occupations.label: document management officer
occupations.isco08Label: Professional services managers not elsewhere classified
occupations.description: Document management officers ensure that the documents required for their organisation's functioning and daily operations are registered, classified and archived correctly and are made available to the different services or to the public upon request. They oversee the implementation of internal procedures and promote proper document management practices within the organisation, providing training to other employees on document management procedures. They may operate electronic records management systems (ERMS), electronic document management systems (EDMS) and archives management systems (AMS) and provide support in defining related technical requirements.

essential.label: monitor developments in field of expertise

optional.label: propose ICT solutions to business problems

occupations.label: clinical informatics manager
occupations.description: Clinical informatics managers oversee the daily operations of information systems used in a medical institutions. They also carry out research, using their understanding of clinical practices to find ways to improve healthcare services.

essential.label: comply with quality standards related to healthcare practice
contribute to continuity of health care
use foreign languages for health-related research

optional.label: communicate in foreign languages with health service providers
comply with legislation related to health care
conditions for professional practice of clinical psychology
data extraction, transformation and loading tools
inform policy makers on health-related challenges
participate in medical records' auditing activities

occupations.label: ICT operations manager
occupations.isco08Label: Information and communications technology service managers
occupations.description: ICT operations managers coordinate ICT services and infrastructure ensuring that the organisation has the required infrastructural resources. They also plan and monitor stages of either a business process or a computer process, negotiate contracts and take mitigation action in case of non-fulfilment of agreements. They oversee the day-to-day tasks involving infrastructure components, ICT systems and software.

occupations.label: software developer
occupations.description: Software developers implement or program all kinds of software systems based on specifications and designs by using programming languages, tools, and platforms.

optional.label: adapt to changes in technological development plans

occupations.label: human resources manager
occupations.description: Human resources managers plan, design and implement processes related to the human capital of companies. They develop programs for recruiting, interviewing, and selecting employees based on a previous assessment of the profile and skills required in the company. Moreover, they manage compensation and development programs for the company's employees comprising trainings, skill assessment and yearly evaluations, promotion, expat programs, and general assurance of the well-being of the employees in the workplace.

essential.label: ensure gender equality in the workplace
plan medium to long term objectives
promote gender equality in business contexts
support employability of people with disabilities

optional.label: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
manage stress in the work place
provide advice on breaches of regulation

occupations.label: user experience analyst
occupations.description: User experience analysts assess client interaction and experience and analyse users' behaviours, attitudes, and emotions about the usage of a particular product, system or service. They make proposals for the improvement of the interface and usability of products, systems or services. In doing so, they take into consideration the practical, experiential, affective, meaningful and valuable aspects of human–computer interaction and product ownership, as well as the person's perceptions of system aspects such as utility, ease of use and efficiency, and user experience dynamics.

essential.label: assess users' interaction with ICT applications
create prototype of user experience solutions

optional.label: test system accessibility for users with special needs

occupations.label: corporate lawyer
occupations.description: Corporate lawyers provide legal consulting services and representation to corporations and organisations. They give advice on matters relating to taxes, legal rights and patents, international trade, trademarks, and legal financial issues arising from operating a business.

optional.label: advise on participation in financial markets

occupations.label: ICT business analyst
occupations.description: ICT business analysts are in charge of analysing and designing an organisation's processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology.
